prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Lawrencium (Lr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a fashion runway under white spotlights
Time of day: daytime indoors — bright, even light filling the room; daylight bouncing softly off pale walls.
Light direction: a low warm light source near her — a lamp, a fire or a screen — glowing on her from below shoulder height.
Outfit: a vintage aviatrix look — a cropped leather flight jacket over a fitted top, high-waisted jodhpurs, goggles pushed up on her head and tall boots — in red-and-white gingham; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a slim leather belt at the waist; right now — mid-task she has pushed her sleeves up above the elbows and opened one more button at the collar, baring her forearms and collarbones, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: lying on her front.
SUPPORT: she lies on her front, propped on her forearms.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands cup her chin, her forearms propped beneath her.
LEGS: lower legs raised behind her, ankles loosely crossed.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — lawrencium: a synthetic metal first made in 1961 in a hillside laboratory by striking californium with boron ions, and named for the inventor of the cyclotron, a round machine in which particles spiral between the poles of a great magnet, kicked a little faster on every turn, grown from a first ring of glass and bronze small enough to sit in a palm to rings the size of a building; the last of the fifteen actinides at the very end of the bottom row of the table, its first symbol later rewritten, its longest-lived form lasting about half a day, and the one of its row that gives up its outermost electron most easily — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
